test_case.test_name: Parameterized 1G TransferBench bidirectional P2P and remote-CPU bandwidth validation
test_case.purpose: Measure every approved 1G bidirectional GPU/peer path using the literal P2P method and the special remote-CPU CFG path, then compare each required result with its approved minimum GB/s threshold.
required_package: Pinned TransferBench binary/source revision, checksum and ROCm/driver compatibility
Stable GPU UUID/BDF, CPU NUMA and complete required endpoint/pair map
Approved `cpu_bid.cfg` with four CPU copy subexecutors and configuration checksum
Per-pair/direction/table minimum GB/s thresholds, warmup/repetition/aggregation rule
Load window, process isolation, thermal/power/timeout aborts and OOB recovery
test_case.test_command: After topology, artifact, config, threshold and load approval, run `USE_GPU_DMA=1 ./TransferBench p2p 1G` and evaluate the second bidirectional table for every required pair. Run `./TransferBench cpu_bid.cfg 1G` using the approved remote-CPU configuration with four CPU copy subexecutors; retain full raw output and endpoint/direction provenance.
test_case.expected_result: Every required endpoint/direction appears in the correct output table and its approved aggregate bandwidth meets the corresponding minimum, with stable topology and no GPU, PCIe/xGMI, CPU, thermal, power, kernel or BMC fault.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires complete pair coverage, correct second-table/CFG interpretation and each approved per-pair threshold. Without an approved threshold, report measured evidence only and do not PASS.
safety_gate: Sustained bandwidth load requires user approval, cooling/power headroom and workload isolation.
Pin GPUs by UUID/BDF and CPUs by NUMA topology; never infer numeric index mapping.
Use the exact approved config and four CPU subexecutors for the remote-CPU case.
Abort on missing peer, hung transfer, topology drift, thermal/power limit, XID/ECC/PCIe/xGMI/kernel/BMC fault; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Source Key/Variant ID and separate thermal-stimulus identity
Full P2P second table and CFG outputs with endpoint/direction labels
Approved threshold table, aggregation, thermal/power/health logs and cleanup
test_case.recovery: Stop only the tracked benchmark processes, preserve raw/config/topology/health evidence, verify all GPUs and links return idle, and escalate any hang or fault. Do not rerun automatically or execute the unrelated thermal stimulus.
